exposure: Cervical ripening with dinoprostone vaginal insert (DVI)
Timing of DVI insertion calculated using a mathematical model
cohort: The study included 628 patients who underwent cervical ripening with dinoprostone vaginal insert (DVI).
finding: The mathematical model developed to predict time to delivery (TTD) did not help in predicting TTD following cervical ripening with DVI, nor did it reduce the number of nocturnal deliveries.
